stem.en: Why would confirming neutrinoless double beta decay be significant beyond just classifying the neutrino?
stem.et: Miks oleks neutriinovaba topeltbeetalagunemise kinnitamine oluline kaugemale ainult neutriino klassifitseerimisest?

label.en: Because it would demonstrate lepton number is not conserved in nature, a result with implications for explaining the universe's matter-antimatter asymmetry.
label.et: Sest see näitaks, et leptoni arv ei ole looduses jääv, tulemus, millel on tähendus universumi aine-antiaine asümmeetria seletamiseks.

label.en: It wouldn't be significant -- ordinary and neutrinoless double beta decay are simply two names for the same already-confirmed, routine process.
label.et: See ei oleks oluline -- tavaline ja neutriinovaba topeltbeetalagunemine on lihtsalt kaks nime samale juba kinnitatud, rutiinsele protsessile.

label.en: Because every known fermion is already confirmed to be a Dirac particle, so the result would simply confirm existing expectations.
label.et: Sest iga teadaolev fermion on juba kinnitatud olevat Diraci osake, seega kinnitaks tulemus lihtsalt olemasolevaid ootusi.

label.en: It wouldn't be significant -- it's purely a matter of academic classification with no broader physical implications at all.
label.et: See ei oleks oluline -- see on puhtalt akadeemilise klassifikatsiooni küsimus, ilma igasuguse laiema füüsikalise tähenduseta.
